title: REINFORCE Loss and Gradient
signature: def reinforce(logits: np.ndarray, actions: np.ndarray, rewards: np.ndarray, gamma: float = 0.99, eps: float = 1e-8) -> tuple
hints: Compute the discounted returns with a backward loop: G_t = r_t + gamma * G_{t+1}.
Normalize: (G - G.mean()) / (G.std() + eps). np.std defaults to the population std (ddof=0), which is what you want.
Use a stable log-softmax: subtract the row max, then log-sum-exp. Pick log pi(a_t) with fancy indexing.
The normalized returns are constants. d loss / d logits = (softmax(logits) - one_hot(actions)) * G_hat[:, None] / T.
